component.name: Digger
component.summary: A client for your slskd Soulseek server

description.p: Digger is a GTK 4 desktop and mobile client for slskd, the Soulseek daemon. It connects to the slskd server you already run and lets you search the Soulseek network, browse other users' shares, manage downloads and uploads, and chat in private conversations and rooms.

ul.li: Search with the same filter syntax as the slskd web interface
Browse users' files and download whole folders
Follow downloads and uploads, retry or remove them in bulk
Private chats and rooms, with notifications for new messages
Server settings: options, YAML editor, share rescan, logs and files
Adapts to phones and small screens

description.p: Digger is an unofficial client and needs a running slskd server. It does not connect to Soulseek by itself.
